entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Warding Light

*A warm light settles over one companion like a hand on the shoulder.*

One willing ally within 3 squares reduces Frightened by 1. Until this creature’s next turn, that ally also has 1 Boon on its next defense against a mental attack; for an NPC ally, impose 1 Bane on that player attack. Consumed even if canceled; does not stack with itself.

entries.name: Cover a Companion
entries.effect: Before an attack on an adjacent ally: +1 Bane if it can obstruct the attacker.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Cover a Companion

*The guardian steps into the line of danger, making the attacker work around its raised guard.*

Before a visible enemy attacks a willing ally adjacent to this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll if this creature can see the attacker. Against an NPC attack, grant that ally 1 Boon to its defense instead. This creature must also be adjacent to the attacker, or hold a shield the DA judges can obstruct the attack. No movement, target substitution or damage transfer. For a single player area attack, use the normal worst-target modifiers; do not roll again.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Lifeless Body:** does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

**Healing:** Spirit: magical healing works; cannot swallow potions.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** A family token grows warm near danger.

**Purpose:** Protect descendants without choosing their lives for them.

**Tactics and retreat:** Stand between danger and the vulnerable; push a threat away.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Appeal to the duty that keeps it here or settle a family wrong.

**Habitat:** Family shrine; home · **Communication:** Languages known in life

**Loot:** An inherited story, burial key or directions to a family cache.

**Summoning:** Spirit 3 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/ancestor-guardian.md).
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-ancestor-guardian


**Category:** Spirit · **Role:** Protector · **CV:** 18

**Difficulty rationale:** No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 3/4/6

**Reference type:** radiant

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.3

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.15 → 1.3: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.000, O=4.162. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [Cover a Companion](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/cover-a-companion.md), [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md), [Warding Light](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/warding-light.md).

monsterAbilityTemplates.flavorMarkdown: *Nothing breathes beneath the torn coat; nothing living looks through the visor.*
monsterAbilityTemplates.rulesMarkdown:
The card must list its exact condition immunities; this trait grants no additional unlisted ones. It does not breathe or need food. Undead entries marked healing-harmed take a healing result as Life damage; constructs marked repair-only do not regain HP from ordinary healing. Neither rule prevents physical attacks from dealing their normal minimum damage.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
